jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Join our dynamic consulting teams at Globalpraxis and embark on a thrilling journey towards business excellence. We are seeking talented individuals who are passionate about leveraging data science to unlock the full potential of top FMCG businesses. As a Data Scientist, you will be a key part of our consulting teams and fully-embedded to the project role.

Details:
• Start date: ASAP
• Location: Barcelona, Spain

Responsibilities: As an integral part of our project teams, you will collaborate closely with our experts to tackle diverse data challenges and immerse yourself in the daily operations of the project. Your key responsibilities will include, within each project:
• Acquiring, cleansing, and standardizing large-scale datasets.
• Conducting in-depth analyses of complex business scenarios.
• Designing and implementing powerful predictive algorithms for various scenarios.
• Generating actionable insights and user-friendly reports that empower our clients to harness the true... potential of their data.
• Lead other analysts in more junior positions.

Requirements: To thrive in this role, we expect you to have the following qualifications:
• At least 2 years of demonstrable experience in data analytics / data science.
• Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering.
• Proficiency in English and Spanish.
• Advanced proficiency in R and/or Python.
• Knowledge and/or experience in PowerBI is considered a plus.
• Experience working with relational databases, including strong SQL query-building skills.

Desired Skills: In addition to the specific qualifications, we value the following skills and attributes:
• Strong analytical skills and a knack for problem-solving.
• Excellent architectural thinking to develop innovative solutions.
• Structured and critical thinking abilities to approach complex challenges.
• Strong interpersonal skills and alignment with our company culture.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a multicultural environment.

Globalpraxis is a renowned international consulting firm known for our blend of academic expertise and dedicated consultants who foster objectivity, creativity, and intellectual rigor. With a strong presence in consumer goods, telecommunications, transportation, pharmaceuticals, and service industries, our strategies in consumer engagement, distribution channels, and customer-centricity have propelled our clients toward global success. With a global reach spanning Europe, Asia, Africa, and the United States, we combine analytical rigor with local insights to become the perfect partner for businesses worldwide.

Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to make a lasting impact on businesses and launch your career forward. Apply now to be a part of our exciting and vibrant team at Globalpraxis

jobs_results.title: Informatiker/In, Data Scientist
jobs_results.description: Machine Learning, Telematik, Big Data, Datenerfassung, Data Science, Informatik, scikit-learn, Python, Künstliche Intelligenz, PyTorch, Cloud Computing Data Scientist in Telematics (f/m/d) Full-time, starting immediately in Coburg, permanent The future of motor insurance is real-time data collection with telematics. We believe that telematics offers great potential for more accurate and, above all, fairer risk assessment. However, exploiting this potential is not trivial and requires a spirit of research and, above all, a high level of expertise in big data & data science. We live and breathe big data: as Germany's largest motor insurer, we receive high-frequency driving data from our telematics customers every day, covering a distance equivalent to 300 times the circumference of the earth. In order to exploit the full potential of this complex and multi-layered data, we use the complete toolbox of a data scientist, from mathematical-statistical methods to state-of-the-art AI. What... you can look forward to Research and development for risk assessment with telematics driving data using data science methods Design and development of complex software solutions based on machine learning algorithms Technical support for the productive implementation of machine learning models Ad-hoc analyses from ongoing operations Teamwork in a motivated and agile team as well as overarching cooperation with related departments What you bring with you Very good degree in computer science, physics, mathematics or a comparable subject, preferably with a doctorate Independent and scientific way of working with creativity and commitment Experience in dealing with modern machine learning methods and relevant libraries in Python (Scikit-learn, PyTorch ...) Experience in the design and development of big data applications Understanding of the principles of software frameworks for distributed scalable systems and cloud computing is an advantage Strong communication skills, mathematical and technical understanding and a goal-oriented and results-oriented way of working Enjoy working with physical and technical data What we offer you Flexible working: As part of our hybrid working concept, you can work from home, on the road or at our headquarters in Coburg. Competence: We promote your consistent professional development in the form of training courses, conferences and anything else that will help you progress. Creative freedom: We trust your abilities and give you the space to drive forward your own ideas and solutions. Performance-related remuneration: We recognize and value your contribution to the company's success and let you share in it. Security: With the strength of our tradition, we focus on success and offer you security. Have we piqued your interest? Then apply now! If you have any questions, please contact Ms. Malina Gorny at the telephone number +49 9561 96-13115,

jobs_results.title: Earth Observation Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Lobelia is a pioneering company in the use of Earth Observation satellites to address the climate emergency. We develop and operate services to study the state of the Earth's resources, and provide key data for adaptation and mitigation measures in face of the climate crisis.

Lobelia's team is composed of passionate experts in physics, earth sciences, graphic design, computer science, data visualisation, engineering and business. We apply this interdisciplinary knowledge to actual products people use and want to use. We work with trusted data providers and have a growing network of international collaborators that are as engaged as we are to drive for change.

Lobelia is looking for an Earth Observation Data Scientist to strengthen its core product team and participate, among others, in our long-term goal to facilitate world-wide access to climate and environmental risks assessment.
• Why you should work at LobeliaSatellite and climate data are becoming increasingly open access and... free of charge, supporting the public and private sector in integrating systemically the human activities footprints on the earth system. However, in practical terms, handling these big earth observation data, combining physical prior knowledge and modelling the risks and derived compound impacts present technical and scientific limitations. At Lobelia, we build on the synergies of transversal fields/disciplines to tackle these inherent challenges. You will work closely with our senior earth observation and climate scientists, in collaboration with our software product team, and will be advised by our environmental experts, to ensure the coordination and fitness of solutions for the engaged stakeholders.
• What you will doYour primary role will be to contribute in implementing algorithms and building processing chains. At Lobelia, this means:

Technically Assess And Identify The Most Suitable Satellite Imagery, Geospatial Datasets And Methodological ApproachCollaborate On Defining And Applying Innovative Data Collection, Processing, Validation, Quality Control StrategiesDesign And Develop Technical Solutions/algorithms Using Geospatial Data, With An Operational Mindset, For Monitoring Ecosystems And Assessing Related RisksAssist The Preparation For Image Pre-processing Of Satellite Data From Multiple Sources Into Optimised Data CubesWork In Close Collaboration With Geospatial Data Engineers To Build Modules Based On AI/ML/RS/GIS And Big DataPrepare Reports Using Integrated Approaches Including Available Open Data And Insights Obtained From In House Algorithms OutputsContribute To The Writing Of Projects Proposals And Concept NotesSupport The Preparation Of Training And Workshop Material, And Information For Meeting And Conferences In Various Media Formats (blog, Speeches, Map Layouts, Posters)3. What You Will BringMust-haves Include

Msc degree in Remote Sensing and Data science4 years working experience in Remote Sensing and GIS with relevant experience in water resources products.Geospatial data and metadata management and remote sensing imagery processing and analysis (raster, gridded and vector data)Mastering geo data processing/data scientist libraries and packages (pandas, geopandas, sklearn, gdal, xarray, rasterio, rioxarray, tensorflow, keras, pytorch, numba + visualization libraries)Experience in applied research in remote sensing (satellite and drone) and artificial intelligenceCapacity to report results to all levels of audiencesNice-to-haves include:

Cloud computing platforms experiencePublications in peer-reviewed journalsWorking knowledge of Spanish or willing to learn4. What we offerWe offer a full-time, permanent position, with a competitive salary. The location for this vacancy is in Barcelona.

Our flexible working conditions do not only exist on paper. All of us take advantage of this flexibility and use it for a good work-life balance.

We offer challenging topics having a societal impact, the best gear to work on them, a stimulating and diverse working environment and an international network of trusted organisations, companies and experts we work with on a daily basis.

But above all, we offer the unique chance to work at the forefront of a social and economic movement to raise awareness on climate change and use evidence-based insights to cope with it in an effective way.
• Tell us about you!If you want to apply for this vacancy, send us an email at ****** telling us about your past, present and ideal future work.Send us your résumé or portfolio, and show us something you've done that makes you feel great. We'll also be very pleased to see some python code and resulting output analysis you have carried out.

Thanks for your interest! We can't wait to hear from you. Location

Barcelona Conditions Full-time, permanent position, with a competitive salary#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Científico De Datos (Área Innovacion)
jobs_results.description:
Científico de datos (Área Innovacion)Normalmente respondemos en un plazo detres días
Somos una firma global de consultoría de comunicación, marketing digital y asuntos públicos. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a tomar decisiones estratégicas dentro del contexto disruptivo e incierto en el que vivimos, teniendo en cuenta su impacto reputacional. Y colaboramos con ellos para que las ejecuten con éxito de forma que puedan alcanzar sus metas de negocio, defender su licencia social para operar y aumentar su prestigio.
Desde LLYC proponemos a nuestros clientes que se anticipen y que "abracen" la disrupción para utilizarla como palanca y no verla a modo de freno. Los esfuerzos en innovación que hemos venido desarrollando han dado lugar a un área, Deep Digital Business, en el que unimos tres disciplinas: Digital, Tecnología / Data Analytics y Marketing Digital. Hoy todos los retos que nos plantean los clientes exigen respuestas que combinan estrategias digitales, despliegues de sistemas basados... en inteligencia artificial y metodologías propias del marketing de captación.
Liderazgo técnico del equipo de análisis de datos e innovación.
Análisis, diseño e implementación de soluciones tecnológicas basadas en la aplicación de inteligencia artificial y técnicas de análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos.
Coordinación y ejecución de proyectos de análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos (Big Data).
Coordinación y ejecución de proyectos de transformación digital orientados al dato (Data-Driven Management).
Elaboración de materiales, comunicación y presentación de los resultados de los antedichos proyectos.
Investigación y diseño de soluciones innovadoras aplicadas a la comunicación, el marketing y los asuntos públicos.
Estudios en: Ingeniería, Tecnologías de Información, Matemáticas, Estadística o afines.
Experiencia mínima de 2 años ocupando posiciones similares.
Experiencia profesional mínima de 4 años en esta u otro tipo de posiciones relacionadas con computer science.
Conocimiento demostrable en desarrollo de proyectos de científica / analítica de datos.
Experiencia en procesado y análisis de datos, tecnología e innovación.
Indispensable alto nivel profesional de inglés.
Conocimientos:
Conocimiento y aplicación de algoritmos de Deep learning para clasificación de textos, por ejemplo uso de algunas de estas librerías: Keras-Rstudio, Tensorflow-Rstudio, Keras, TensorFlow, Pytorch, Transformers, Fastai.
Lenguajes de Programación: Python.
Infraestructura: conocimiento en soluciones Google Cloud / AWS.
• Capacidad analítica y de resolución de problemas.
• Pensamiento crítico.
• Orientación al resultado.
• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo.
• Autodidacta y proactivo.
• En constante conocimiento de las tendencias actuales.
En LLYC creemos en la diversidad e inclusión. Estamos comprometidos en promover un lugar y ambiente de trabajo diverso e incluyente, en el cual todo nuestro personal, sin importar su género, edad, origen étnico, condición social o económica, orientación sexual, expresión o identidad de género, condición física o de salud, religión, afiliación política, o cualquiera otra diferencia o condición, tenga la oportunidad real de desarrollarse y alcanzar su potencial.

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Desde LHH nos gustaría incorporar a un Senior Data Scienstist, dentro del departamento de AI/ML & Advanced Analytics Projects, para uno de los bancos mas grandes del país.

Objetivo y Relevancia dentro de la Organización

El equipo se dedica a desarrollar nuevos proyectos de analítica avanzada para las distintas áreas de negocio y dar mantenimiento y optimización de los modelos core que dan soporte al plan comercial.

Además, se da soporte transversal a todo el banco en coordinación con sistemas, implantación de nuevas tecnologías, generación de capacidades, etc.

El departamento se caracteriza por ser muy dinámico, resolutivo, con alta capacidad analítica y con mucho espíritu de colaboración.

Si posee experiencia en coordinación y alineación con los diferentes stakeholders internos y externos: Business Intelligence, Áreas de Negocio, Digital Sales, Contact Center, entre otros, para conseguir los objetivos de ventas marcados.

¿Qué funciones desarrollarás?

Dentro del área de AI/ML ... Advanced Business Analytics dedicamos nuestros esfuerzos diarios a temas como los siguientes:
• Sesiones con las distintas áreas de negocio del banco para detectar sus necesidades e identificar la mejor forma de ayudarles a resolver sus problemas por medio de la analítica avanzada.
• Diseñar y construir distintos modelos de Machine Learning para ayudar a resolver las problemáticas identificadas. El abanico de técnicas es muy amplio, desde modelos de propensión a soluciones de NLP, pasando por otras estrategias como técnicas de clustering. A menudo necesitarás buscar nuevos enfoques y técnicas, pues los problemas son complejos, aunque manteniendo siempre un equilibrio entre la innovación de las soluciones que implementamos y su robusted y rapidez.
• Diseñar, construir y actualizar distintos análisis que permitan a las áreas de negocio tomar decisiones. La solución no siempre es un modelo.
• Localizar y tratar la información necesaria para los modelos o análisis pertinentes, partiendo ya de un enorme Feature Store con varios miles de variables industrializadas para las primeras iteraciones.
• Comunicación de los resultados y conclusiones de dichos modelos o análisis. Dada la complejidad de algunas de las soluciones es una tarea no menor, que puede marcar buena parte del éxito o fracaso del trabajo realizado.
• Desayunar, comer, charlar sobre tu fin de semana, bromear o pedir consejo sobre tu proyecto son algunas de las cosas que harás, siempre que quieras, a diario. Somos un equipo y como tal trabajamos y nos relacionamos, el buen ambiente está garantizado.

Requisitos
• Formación y conocimientos:
• Dominio de Python.
• Dominio de SQL.
• Dominio de distintas técnicas de machine learning.
• Preferible Grado, Licenciatura o Diplomatura en carreras STEM.
• Experiencia en Cloud (Preferiblemente Google Cloud Platform).

Actitudes / Habilidades:
• Perfil analítico, con capacidad de gestionar problemas complejos.
• Creatividad, tanto para preparar presentaciones para perfiles no técnicos. como para buscar soluciones innovadores a los problemas planteados.
• Trabajo en equipo.

Competencias:
• Python - avanzado
• SQL - avanzado
• Microsoft Office Avanzado, especialmente en power point y en excel

Experiencia:
• Al menos 4 años trabajando en análisis datos y modelos de ML

jobs_results.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
The Opportunity

As a Junior Data Scientist, you will be joining our Analytics department working on a hybrid basis in Madrid. This role requires a high degree of proficiency in both Spanish and English and we would invite you to submit your application in English.

You will play a crucial role in helping us achieve our goals and deliver success on behalf of our customers by building advanced statistical models and algorithms that infer and predict individual customer behaviours in real-time, based on retail, online and ecommerce transaction data.

We are experiencing a continued period of great success winning big deals with customers in Latin America, as well as across the EMEA region. This has been a big factor in our decision to build an Analytics presence in Spain to support our customers. For this role you will be working with global customers that require periodic work outside of standard hours (evening work) and international travel around once a quarter.

Day to Day
•... Applying analytical theory to diverse real-world problems on large and dynamic datasets
• Generating integral work products from project kick-off through to live deployment
• Contributing to the development of statistical models and algorithms for integration within Featurespace products
• End-to-end processing and modelling of large customer data sets
• Producing materials to feedback analytic output to customers (reports, presentations, visualizations)
• Working collaboratively with customers to develop and optimize models tailored to their data
• Evaluating and improving analytical results on live systems
• Developing an understanding of industry data structures and processes
• Working with engineering/development teams to support and enhance the analytical infrastructure
• Testing analytical models and their integration within the ARIC platform

About you

Must haves:
• Good degree in a scientific or numerate discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering) or equivalent work experience
• Strong, clear, concise written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish
• Evidence of interest in machine learning
• Experience in utilising statistical models and analytical algorithms in software
• Experience using Python, Java, R or another major programming language for data analysis, machine learning or algorithm development
• Technical and analytical skills with the ability to pick up new technologies and concepts quickly
• Problem-solving skills (especially in data-centric applications)
• Strong communication skills
• Ability to manage and prioritise personal workload

Great to haves:
• Exposure to the handling of large, diverse, real-world data sets
• Experience working in a Linux command line environment
• Experience using SQL to analyse data
• Experience with version control software and workflows (e.g. git)

Equal Opportunities

Here at Featurespace we are committed to being a place of equality, inclusion and respect to provide a safe environment for you to bring your authentic self to work. We know that we gain as much strength from our differences as we do our similarities. We value diversity and are dedicated to listening and learning from each other to build and maintain a positive and productive culture. We appreciate this will be an ever-evolving focus for the business to ensure everyone feels supported and has a sense of belonging

jobs_results.title: DATA Scientist
jobs_results.description:
At the SEAT:CODE we are constantly looking for talented people willing to join our projects. Our start-up environment is very open minded, we love to test and implement new ideas. If you think you are ready to enjoy your work and be part of our big family, we invite you to keep reading what we think it could be a good fit for our current needs 😊.

The Data Scientist role 🤔
• Develop solutions using a range of data science techniques
• Implement and understand a range of data science techniques and be able to develop models including machine learning
• Collaborate with the team to develop data science solutions according to business needs
• Perform analytics on data
• Able to recognise and exploit business opportunities to ensure more efficient and effective performance of organisations
• Develop data science solutions that are fit for purpose, resilient, scalable and future-proof, to meet user needs
• Help team to achieve their goals and be aligned to business needs.

About the Team... 🤗
• Our technical Team loves to deliver really well-crafted solutions at decent speed. We love tech so we really give great attention to the technology (Technology as first class Citizen)
• We know that small, empowered, self-motivated teams can do big things.
• We like to measure everything, so we are always improving, for that we use the best tools on the market such as Datadog.
• Finally, we promote a culture of no blame, trust, and learning, and we support the mantra “if it hurts do it more often” so good CI and CD are really key for us.

What we offer 🤩
• Possibility to work remotely within Spain (you can work from any city of Spain 😎)
• 2.000€ per year in social benefits to choose from: restaurant, kindergarten, health Insurance, private insurance, fuel, transportation, gym pass, cleaning services, WIFI, Holaluz contract, etc.
• 2.000€ per year in trainings
• Free language courses
• Daily Snacks: We try to promote healthy living habits. You will find in our canteen many nuts, fresh fruit, salads, ...
• Flexible working hours: We understand the importance of work-life balance.
• Short Fridays
• 26 days for your vacations
• Best technology for your needs
• Nice located offices in Poblenou

MIN REQUIREMENTS:

What we are expecting from you 🥰
• At least 3 years of experience working with Python and SQL.
• At least 3 years of experience working with Industrial optimization and simulation projects.
• Experience with AWS services like Sagemaker and S3 at least. Glue and lambda knowledge would be a plus
• Knowledge on Git
• Research background
• Methodical and logical approach along with creativity when approaching a problem
• Knowledge on how to apply statistical methods including exploratory analysis and statistical testing to a specific data set
• Be able to obtain conclusions from a data set
• Able to log, analyse and manage problems to identify and implement the appropriate solution
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to identify and communicate data driven insights in a clear and effective manner
• Curiosity and thirst for knowledge
• Advocate for feedback
• Actively pursue improving skills
• Collaborate with others for learning and achieving goals together
• Generative AI
• Occasional availability to work at the offices in Martorell

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Somos Banco Sabadell

Banco Sabadell es una de las principales entidades bancarias en España con más de 17.000 personas caracterizadas por nuestra implicación, espíritu de colaboración y dinamismo. Banco Sabadell ofrece sus servicios a más de 11 millones de clientes contando con una posición privilegiada en el segmento de empresas.

Nuestra razón de ser es ayudar a personas y empresas a hacer realidad sus proyectos, anticipándonos y ocupándonos de que tomen las mejores decisiones económicas, a través de nuestros valores: el compromiso, no conformismo, profesionalidad, eficacia, empatía y franqueza.

Y además, lo hacemos mediante una gestión responsable y comprometida con el medio ambiente.

¡Únete a nosotros!

¿Qué estamos buscando?

Actualmente buscamos nuestro/nuestra futuro/futura Data Scientist cuya misión principal es participar en las auditorías de los modelos IRB y parámetros de riesgo de crédito (PD, LGD, EAD), IFRS9 y ICAAP, incluyendo los siguientes aspectos a revisar... desarrollo de modelos, calibración de parámetros y revisión de los ejercicios de validación.

Hablemos del proyecto...

Tus funciones y responsabilidades consistirán en:
• Ejecutar las actuaciones del plan de auditoría interna, incluyendo el establecimiento de objetivos, alcance y programa de trabajo. Desarrollar las pruebas de auditoría con la colaboración de los recursos asignados en cada proyecto, asegurando la adecuada documentación de los programas de trabajo y los resultados de las pruebas.
• Elaboración de los informes de auditoría y comunicación de los resultados de las revisiones efectuadas a las áreas auditadas, con las conclusiones y recomendaciones aplicables a las partes interesadas.
• Efectuar el seguimiento de las recomendaciones de auditoría, verificando la implantación de las mismas.
• Revisar el cumplimiento con la regulación, expectativas y planes de remediación comprometidos con el supervisor.
• Participar en las inspecciones del Supervisor sobre modelos internos, cartera de crédito y capital, en las que se requiera de la involucración de la función de Auditoría Interna.

¿Qué valoramos de tu candidatura?
• Has estudiado Licenciatura o Grado en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería.
• Tienes conocimientos de programación y modelización de datos. Se valorará experiencia en áreas relacionadas con la construcción de modelos y parámetros de riesgo.
• Imprescindible manejo avanzado de la herramienta estadística SAS y lenguaje SQL, os similar (Python, etc), así como otros programas para realizar tratamiento masivo de datos.
• Se valorará cocimiento de la normativa prudencial y de riesgos, así como la normativa contable para la calificación de estos riesgos.
• Inglés avanzado.

Banco Sabadell está comprometido en promover ambientes de trabajo en los que se trate con respeto y dignidad a las personas, procurando el desarrollo profesional de la plantilla y garantizando la igualdad de oportunidades en su selección, formación y promoción ofreciendo un entorno de trabajo libre de cualquier discriminación por motivo de género, edad, orientación sexual, religión, etnia o cualquier otra circunstancia personal o social.

Banco Sabadell forma parte de la red de empresas con el distintivo de “Igualdad en la Empresa” otorgado por el Ministerio de Igualdad
